verdict.rationale: No notification feature is documented. The closest evidence is a marketing line about approving big calls from your phone, which implies some mobile approval flow. Beyond that, an Agents dashboard shows each worker's task and last message, and agents open pull requests when work is done; developers can check these, but nothing pushes an alert to them. Missing for 10: an explicit notification mechanism (push, email, Slack, or webhook) for task completion, alerts when an agent is blocked and needs input mid-task, configurable notification settings, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
